unlisted_practices: Integrate speech science and clinical research insights into clinical speech AI model design to reduce sample complexity and overfitting.
Use lower-dimensional, individually validated, clinically interpretable speech measures rather than high-dimensional uninterpretable features for high-stakes clinical use.
Assess how directly a health condition affects speech and how accurate and specific its ground truth labels are before building a speech AI model.
Validate clinical speech AI end-to-end using the V3 framework (hardware verification, analytical validation, clinical validation) before deployment.
Broaden clinical speech training data collection to cover diverse demographics and native languages.
Use uncertainty modeling and noise-robust training techniques when diagnostic labels are noisy.
Adopt privacy-protecting techniques such as differential privacy and federated learning and stringent data protection regulations for health speech data.
Make only evidence-backed claims about AI-driven products.
